name: Formerly, A Confession
source:
You’ve been away for a year studying in another city. Meanwhile, your childhood friend Kiyon was completing his final year of high school. Now that the year is finally winding down, Kiyon invites you to his 18th birthday party. 

This might be the last time the two of you can talk like this.

[From [url=https://goinggoingkeith.itch.io/formerly-a-confession]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已经离开另一个城市一年了。与此同时，你儿时的朋友Kiyon即将完成高中最后一年的学业。今年终于结束了，Kiyon邀请你参加他的18岁生日聚会。

这可能是你们两个最后一次这样说话了。

[来自[url=https://goinggoingkeith.itch.io/formerly-a-confession]Itch.io[/url]]
